structure: Single-grade Vermont draft framework document (Grade 4 - Vermont, the Early Republic and the U.S.). Front matter: header banner, title, Overview narrative, Looking Back/Looking Ahead, Inquiry rationale and contact. Inquiry: 'Critical Proficiency (K-12)' Inquiry Process statement and three Priority Performance Indicators for grades 3-5 (Constructing Compelling and Supporting Questions; Gathering and Evaluating Sources; Communicating and Critiquing Solutions), then Overarching Themes. Body is organized by four subject sections (Civics, Economics, Geography, History); each opens with a K-12 'Critical Proficiency' statement and a 'Theme:' line, followed by 3-column tables: R1 headers 'Priority Performance Indicator (PPI)' | 'Sample PPI Connections' | 'Sample Content Connections'; each later row = one C3 strand (strand name + PPI text with D2 dimension numbers in C1; 'Students will be able to...' expectations in C2; bulleted sample content in C3). Rows continued over pages show '(continued)'. Each subject ends with a 'Resources' list. No state-specific standard codes. Labeling: title, themes, critical proficiency, PPIs (C1) and 'Students will' expectations (C2) = standards; sample content (C3), Overview narrative and Resources = examples; Looking Back/Ahead, inquiry rationale, 'not in this grade' notes and 'Intentionally blank' cells = backup.

issues: Inquiry Process / C3-indicator / Priority Performance Indicator lists that name a band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8) or K-12 are labeled with that band (shared inquiry skills); everything else is labeled with this file's single grade, per the state guide (one document = one grade).
Resource entries that wrap across pages are split into two units (second unit continues the first); both are labeled examples.
'Note:' lines saying an indicator is not addressed in this grade, and the 'Looking Back/Looking Ahead' paragraphs, are labeled backup.
u44-u46: 'Rules, Processes, and Laws' row has the Civic Virtues PPI text copied in C1 (document copy error); labeled standards as extracted.
u91: expectation text contains typos ('United State', 'pre-colonial United S') as extracted.
u147: C2 cell reads '(Continued)'; labeled standards (table continuation).
